# spx_subnet (Resource)

Manages a Subnet on SPX.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "spx_vpc" "example" {
  name = "my-vpc"
}

# Public IPv4 subnet with a NAT gateway for outbound Internet access
resource "spx_subnet" "example" {
  name        = "my-subnet"
  vpc_id      = spx_vpc.example.id
  protocol    = "IPv4"
  ipv4        = "10.11.12.0/24"
  private     = false
  dns_v4      = "8.8.8.8"
  nat_gateway = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the Subnet.
- `protocol` (String) The protocol (IPv4, IPv6, Dual).
- `vpc_id` (String) The ID of the parent VPC.

### Optional

- `az` (String) The availability zone of the Subnet. If not set, the provider value is used.
- `dns_v4` (String) The IPv4 DNS server.
- `dns_v6` (String) The IPv6 DNS server.
- `ipv4` (String) The IPv4 CIDR block.
- `ipv6` (String) The IPv6 CIDR block.
- `nat_gateway` (Boolean) Whether to enable NAT Gateway.
- `orga_id` (String) The organization ID. If not set, the provider value is used.
- `private` (Boolean) Whether the subnet is private.
- `project_id` (String) The project ID. If not set, the provider value is used.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the Subnet.
- `nat_gateway_ip` (String) The IP address of the NAT Gateway.
